Undelucram.ro on behalf of:
 Veeam Software
 Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.
 About The Role
 Technical Customer Support is our customers’ “hotline.” It is the department that has revolutionized the way we think about technical support: one-on-one, hands-on, and accountable from first contact to resolution — leaving customers with a positive impression and giving our developers and testers invaluable feedback from the field.
Veeam Backup & Replication (VBR) lets our customers verify the recoverability of their backups, recover instantly, and test upgrades in an isolated environment before moving to production. As a Technical Support Engineer, you are a trusted advisor to fellow IT professionals, using broad and in-depth troubleshooting skills and product knowledge to solve challenging technical issues across backup, virtualization, storage, networking, Windows, and Linux environments.
We are now looking for a Technical Support Engineer with Japanese to support our Japanese-speaking customer base from Bucharest. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role suited to an engineer with at least 3 years of technical support experience who enjoys solving hard technical problems, learning complex technologies, and owning issues through to resolution.
 What You’ll Do
 Customer Technical Support
Provide technical support to B2B customers via phone, email, remote sessions, and web conferencing 
Take ownership of assigned cases from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation 
Act as a technical focal point for fellow IT professionals, in both Japanese and English 
Research and troubleshoot backup, recovery, virtualization, storage, networking, and operating system issues 
 Troubleshooting & Technical Analysis
Perform structured troubleshooting and log file analysis across common customer environments, including: 
Veeam Backup & Replication and related data protection concepts 
Virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V 
Windows Server and Linux operating systems 
Storage, networking, and performance-related scenarios 
Troubleshoot both in Veeam and in third-party components from Microsoft and VMware, determining whether an issue is known or unknown, a defect, or the result of configuration, environment, or usage 
Correct issues as break/fix scenarios and educate the customer by explaining how the process and interactions work 
Reproduce customer issues in lab environments when needed to support investigation and escalation 
 Case Management & Documentation
Update and manage support cases accurately and within SLA expectations 
Document troubleshooting steps, customer communications, findings, and resolution details clearly in our CRM tool 
Escalate cases with complete technical evidence when additional assistance from senior support, engineering, or product teams is required 
 Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement
Contribute to KCS articles, internal notes, and troubleshooting guidance based on resolved cases 
Share useful findings with teammates to improve consistency and resolution quality 
Provide clear technical feedback when recurring product, documentation, or process issues are identified 
 Customer & Stakeholder Communication
Communicate clearly and professionally with customers throughout the case lifecycle 
Explain technical findings, next steps, and workarounds in language that is easy for customers to understand 
Collaborate with senior support engineers, escalation teams, and product specialists when deeper investigation is required 
 What You’ll Bring
 Language
Business-level Japanese (JLPT N2 or equivalent) — required 
Fluent English, written and spoken — required 
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly with Japanese customers and internal stakeholders 
 Technical
3+ years of experience in technical support, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a similar customer-facing technical role 
Working knowledge of backup and recovery concepts, with the interest to develop deeper expertise in Veeam solutions 
Advanced user or administrative level with Windows Server 2016 / 2019 / 2022 / 2025 and Windows 10 / 11 
Practical knowledge of TCP/IP (OS and firewall configuration) and networking configuration and troubleshooting (NAT, ports, DHCP, DNS) 
Hands-on experience or practical familiarity with VMware vSphere / ESXi and/or Microsoft Hyper-V 
Basic Linux administration, storage concepts, and performance troubleshooting 
Log review, issue reproduction, and structured troubleshooting methodologies 
Ability to follow technical documentation, validate assumptions, and escalate with clear evidence when needed 
 Professional Skills & Mindset
Customer-focused mindset, staying calm and structured when working on complex technical issues 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics simply 
Ability to quickly learn, understand, and explain technical information 
Ability to manage multiple support cases, prioritize work, and follow through on commitments 
Excellent time management and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment 
Curiosity, ownership, and willingness to learn from senior engineers and product specialists 
 Bonus Skills
Experience supporting backup, virtualization, storage, or infrastructure platforms 
UNIX and/or Linux knowledge, Microsoft Exchange administration, or database engines (SQL / Oracle) 
Veeam VMCE, VMware, Microsoft, Linux, networking, or cloud-related certifications 
Experience working in a global or distributed support organization 
Familiarity with enterprise customer environments and escalation processes 
 What You’ll Get
21 annual vacation days, additional days based on tenure, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
Private health, dental, and vision insurance for employees and dependents, including outpatient care, hospitalization, pregnancy monitoring, and psychology support
Monthly lifestyle and daily meal benefits: 40 RON/day via Edenred and 600 RON/month through a flexible cafeteria platform
Life insurance (2× annual gross salary), critical illness, and disability coverage, plus vision reimbursement
Free access to Bookster library platform for borrowing your favorite books for free
Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning
